title: Nea Ahenni Bi Kotow Ne Nsɛnkyerɛnne Ansa Na
intro: Akwantu a ɛyɛ nwonwa retwɛn wɔn a wɔwɔ akokoduru bedi ahintasɛm yi ho dwuma no. Wɔ Adiyisɛm nkratafa mu tɔnn no, na ɔhene bi wɔ hɔ a odiyifo bi a obehyia no bɛsan asiesie ɔman mũ bi. Saa onipa yi fii ahengua a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri so dii tumi, a tete atetesɛm kyerɛɛ no ​​kwan, kosii sɛ ɔsoro nokware bere soronko bi sesaa sodifo ne ahemman nyinaa daa. So wubehu onii ko a ɔkra nwonwaso yi a n’asɛm no ka nneɛma soronko ne nea emu dɔ bom no ho?
clues: Midii ɔman bi a wodi yiye so wɔ nsu a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri, a na agye din wɔ yɛn turo ne ahemfie atenten ho.
Na me tumidi korɔn, nanso ahenni kɛse bi bae sɛ ɛbɛkasa atia yɛn asetra ne yɛn nipasu ankasa.
Ná anomaa ketewaa bi kura nkrasɛm soronko bi, na anwonwade a edii akyi bae no bubuu m’adwene a na mewɔ wɔ tumi ho nyinaa.
Bere a mihuu ahengua bi a wɔasakra wɔ m’ani so no, na minim sɛ onipa biara nni hɔ a obetumi anya tumi a ɛte saa.
Mekaa m’ahobrɛaseɛ maa ɔsoro ne asase Awurade Baako no pefee, na migyaee nea bere bi na mepɛ no nyinaa.
Yɛn, sɛ ɔman no, yɛtwee yɛn ho fii tete owia som ho na yegyee nokware a ɛsakraa biribiara no toom.

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
